items.name: EBA AI/ML Guidelines
items.description: EBA guidelines and reports relevant to AI/ML in European financial institutions, referenced by section only: our own-language paraphrase; no EBA text is embedded

requirements.text: Financial entities' ICT and security risk management frameworks cover AI systems, applying EBA ICT guidelines' governance, protection and resilience requirements.
requirements.rationale: AI systems are ICT assets; excluding them from the ICT framework leaves them ungoverned.

controls.description: Register AI systems within the ICT risk framework with owner, criticality and incident routes defined.

requirements.text: Third-party AI services are governed under EBA outsourcing expectations and their successors - the ICT guidelines (EBA/GL/2022/03) for ICT-dependent services and the non-ICT third-party risk guidelines for the rest - including due diligence and contractual requirements.
requirements.rationale: Vendor-supplied AI carries the same outsourcing risk as any other material function.

controls.description: Perform documented due diligence and register contractual terms for every third-party AI provider.

requirements.text: The EBA report on AI and machine learning in credit scoring examines AI/ML use in credit decisions and recommends governance practices for model development, validation and explainability.
requirements.rationale: Credit decisions are consequential; the EBA set out governance expectations for AI in this use specifically.

controls.description: Apply report recommendations to AI/ML credit models: explainability, performance monitoring and validation.
